verdicts.reason: The two candidates are effectively identical, so this is a tie. In both, the skates are scaled up and cropped at the top, and the skate blade now nearly touches the 'ICE' headline. The text block, divider and 'LINK IN BIO' button stay in a narrow central column with dead space on both sides. The decorative circles that the canvas edge cut in the original are now clipped arcs floating mid-canvas (left of the button and lower right), which looks like a rendering error.
